sectionDescription: Most coaches give you generic advice. I give you the exact playbook bar raisers use to evaluate you.

steps.title: 15-Min Reality Check
steps.description: Quick call. I ask hard questions about your prep. You find out if you're actually ready, or just think you are.

steps.title: Blind Spot Audit
steps.description: I run you through the actual rubrics FAANG uses. You'll see exactly where you'd fail, and what we need to fix first.

steps.title: Your Attack Plan
steps.description: No fluff. A clear list of what to fix, in what order, based on your interview date. Everything prioritized by impact.

steps.title: Live Pressure Sessions
steps.description: Real-time whiteboarding. Mock interviews that feel like the real thing. Direct feedback. All recorded for your review.

steps.title: Until You Get In
steps.description: WhatsApp access for quick questions. Async feedback on your stories and designs. I'm with you until you get the offer.

transparency.title: No Games
points: All sessions recorded. Yours to keep.
